arguments.message: Hi there! To combine the two customer records, you can re‑import a corrected file that includes the record you want to keep and make sure it contains either the same email address (or the record’s unique identifier, if you have one). During the import, Meridian’s importer will match the incoming data to the existing record and update it in place instead of creating a second copy, effectively merging the histories. Just upload the file with the matching email/ID and the system will handle the merge for you.
